description.text: Core courses Advanced Mathematics, College Physics, Computer fondation, Inorganic Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physics Chemistry, Solid Waste Control Engineering, Water Pollution Control Engineering, Environmental Monitoring Technique, Environmental Impact Assessment, Environmental Microbiology. Objective This objective is to train students to be high-qualified technical personnel, working in government departments, planning units, environmental protection sectors, industrial and mining enterprises, research institutions, colleges and universities, or middle schools for various career pursuits in the fields of planning, design, construction, management, teaching and research. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Engineering is granted.

duration.text: The Environmental Engineering at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/In total ￥ 15000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
